items.title: Highgate Wood - Autumn guided walk
items.summary: Enjoy an guided walk exploring the season of Autumn in Highgate Wood, led by their staff. All guided walks are free to attend with no booking required. They last approximately 1 to 1.a5 hours. Meet at the information hut next to the café. For more information and to book click the link below . Learn more

items.title: Queen’s Park Autumn Walk
items.summary: Join us for a guided walk of Queen’s Park, celebrating the season of Autumn. We’ll be taking a look at seasonal changes, hedgerows and more. The walk will meet outside the Queen’s Park Cafe - further instructions to be provided on booking. All welcome, including children of any age - but anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. The walk is free (donations welcome) but booking is essential. Book here

items.title: Queen’s Park Family Autumn Activities
items.summary: Join us for an afternoon of autumn-themed family fun in Queens Park. Make a leaf crown, join a scavenger hunt, and learn about the seasonal changes in the trees and hedgerows around you. We’ll be located near the cafe from 2pm onwards. All welcome, including children of any age - but anyone under 18 should be accompanied by a responsible adult. This activity is free, and no booking is required. We strongly reccomed arriving at 2pm to take advantage of all activities on offer.

items.title: Gardening Volunteering
items.summary: Join our open volunteering sessions! We’ll be gardening and taking part in light conservation tasks around the Hive area. All ages welcome to join - children under 11 should be accompanied by a responsible adult, children aged 12-17 can be dropped off by an adult. All equipment provided, as well as tea and biscuits! No need to book: you can just turn up or you’re welcome to email us so we have a rough idea of numbers. Please arrive prompty for the session start at 2pm.

items.title: Youth Twilight Walk
items.summary: Join us for the launch event of our new Youth programme: Hampstead Heath Eco Club . Learn about our future plans for the club: events, workshops, walks and more, then join us for a guided walk, exploring the Heath at twilight. Will you be lucky enough to hear an owl? Spot a bat? We’ll have UV torches to discover the hidden world of illuminescence, as well as our trusty bat detectors. This is a youth event , open to children age 10-17 only . Booking is required (click the button below), and we’ll send joining instructions prior to the walk. The walk will meet in the Parliament Hill area - further details provided on booking. Book here

You can: pick up a free map or nature sheet find out about upcoming events and activities ask questions of our friendly team buy Hampstead Heath-related goodies (e.g. books, cards, bags)

items.summary: Come and view our Nature Interpretation Centre to find out more about the wildlife across the Heath’s green spaces. Pick up a leaflet, check out our specimens and find out what’s coming up! Interpretation centre displays.

items.title: Litter pick
items.summary: Join us for a Saturday afternoon litter pick. All welcome and all equipment provided. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

items.title: Wild about Hampstead Heath
items.summary: Come and find out about nature on our green spaces with our volunteer wildlife interpreters. All welcome, drop in anytime between 2 and 4pm, no need to book. Look out for the big Wild About Hampstead Heath bike, in the Parliament Hill area.

items.title: LNHS - Introduction to Fungi
items.summary: Join the London Natural History Society (LNHS) for an introduction to fungi on Hampstead Heath lead by Mario Tortelli. Meeting at Hampstead Heath overground station. Bring lunch, toilets on the Heath. Due to high demand places may be limited. Email hampsteadbookings@lnhs.org.uk to register, with the name and date of the walk in the subject. Click below for more information and exact meeting points on the LNHS website. More info

items.title: Kenwood Events Consultation
items.summary: Kenwood House and English Heritage welcome the public to attend their Autumn Public Events Consultation Meeting to learn more about their upcoming events. The Consultation will take place on Monday 2 November at Kenwood from 6.30 to 8pm in the Old Kitchen. Access to the grounds will be via East Lodge from 6pm . English Heritage would be grateful if you could confirm your attendance by emailing Kenwood.house@english-heritage.org.uk This event and associated ticketing and personal data capture is managed directly by English Heritage. Learn more

items.title: Forest Bathing
items.summary: Join us for a 1.5-2 hour gentle walk on Hampstead Heath to discover and explore the practice of forest bathing, and reconnect with nature through mindfulness exercises. Children aged 12 or over are welcome, but should be accompanied by a responsible adult. Spaces are limited - click below to book. The walk will meet in the Parliament Hill area - book on for full details and meeting point. Due to many people booking on and then not showing up, we are now asking for a £5 donation for these workshops, but if this is unaffordable, please get in touch ! Book here

items.title: Keats House: The Spooky and Sublime John Keats
items.summary: The year turns and the nights draw in, which makes this the perfect moment to join poets Julia Bird and Mike Sims for a social afternoon of readings and conversation exploring the shadowy side of Keats's work. Expect the Gothic thrills of 'La Belle Dame Sans Merci', the ghostly visions of 'Isabella, or The Pot of Basil' and a summoning of the witches and elves which lurk in the corners of his poems. This event and any associated ticketing and personal data capture is managed directly by the City of London Corporation. Learn more

items.title: Keats House: Place-Based Writing Workshop
items.summary: How do we translate a physical landscape into an invisible feeling? Join critically acclaimed songwriter Étáin for an immersive, two-hour creative writing workshop in the historic grounds of Keats House. The workshop will be followed by a 30-minute performance by Étáin. This event and any associated ticketing and personal data capture is managed directly by the City of London Corporation. Learn more
